messages:
tom: Heads-up: Nova accelerator EAP kicked off. NDA signed. Need to coordinate image drop + bench plan. @anya can infra carve a slot? :wave:
anya: Yep. Can provision nova-usw1-02 today. Will hand over ssh key + kube creds by 18:00 PT.
tom: Partner asks for: (1) simple end-to-end perf script; (2) token-level latency and GPU memory telemetry delivered to their S3; (3) rollback procedure if runs fail.
nova-eng (partner): Confirm S3 bucket name s3://nova-eap-results and IAM role arn:aws:iam::999999999:role/nova-eap-ingest allowed. Telemetry schema matches earlier doc.
anya: Operational constraints: use MAX_BATCH=4, MAX_SEQ=1536 to avoid early OOMs. Pin driver to 2.5.3. Also enable cgroup memory limits in the pod.
tom: I'll author bench script. Suggested command for ENG: `./bench/run_nova.sh --model redwood-7b --seq 1536 --iters 40`
tom: sample output we expect:
```
WARMUP: 3
avg_latency: 36ms/token
p95_latency: 70ms
gpu_peak_mb: 12100
```
ops-bot: bench job queued: nova-bench-3245 on nova-usw1-02 (job id 3245).
bench-bot: upload started to s3://nova-eap-results/1829998765/results.json
nova-eng (partner): We require that no customer PII leaves the VPC. Aggregated telemetry only (per NDA). We'll validate access logs.
tom: Noted. We'll provide anonymization + retention policy. Also adding fallback rule: if p95 > 20% of ref, auto-fallback to quantized-7b. I'll document in runbook.
anya: I'll add restart-on-failure with exponential backoff (30s -> 60s). Also exposing /metrics endpoint for partner scraping.
tom: Timeline: infra creds by 18:00 PT (anya), bench script by me today, first full run by tomorrow morning, telemetry policy doc by legal/ops EOD Monday. Any objections?
nova-eng (partner): ack from partner side. Looking forward to the results.
anya: ack
tom: thanks team :+1:
